title: An Innovative Solution to Improve Ultra Low Voltage Writability and Leakage in GPU SRAMs
problem: GPU SRAM scaling to 3nm fails at ultra-low voltage (ULV); write failures and high leakage due to bit-cell scaling
motivation: LLM training demands GPU scaling; mobile power optimization requires ULV operation; SRAM scaling bottleneck
method: Innovative circuit solutions in 3nm SRAM for ULV write-ability and leakage reduction
key_novelty: 3nm SRAM circuit techniques enabling reliable ULV writes with leakage gains
